set.body: From the storyatlas4s app review (app-review, 2026-08-29): the Laminar shell had to invent on-annotation/not-annotated because NavigationIndex.annotationsFor (view/codex.scala:298) is exact-target only and CodexFlow carries no selection placements; off-horizon vs no-channel collapse. Compute Map[Address, SelectionPlacement] in CodexCompiler with the same V-L2 enum the Atlas uses (SelectionPreserved), add ancestor resolution to NavigationIndex, print in the twin, one ADR 0002 sentence. Can ride with the feature-scale parity bead if the planner refactor touches the same code. Gate: view + fixtures JVM/JS/Native.
set.title: view: CodexFlow.selectionPlacements — V-L2 placement (OnMark | ViaAncestor | OffProjection) computed in the compiler for the Codex, so no app-side placement logic exists; NavigationIndex.annotationsFor gains ancestor resolution; ADR 0002 line
